ScreenPlan.description: One screen: its identity, what it shows and which screens its buttons open.

id.description: PascalCase ASCII identifier (letters and digits, starting with a capital, not ending in 'Screen'), unique ignoring letter case. The generator derives code from it.
id.title: Id

title.description: The headline of the screen, and the label of every button that opens it. Display text: letters, digits and a few marks (space _ - . ' & , ( ) ! +), no markup.
title.title: Title

description.description: Optional line of text under the title (display text).
description.title: Description

navigates_to.description: Ids of the screens this screen opens, one button each, in this order. Each must exist, not be this screen and not repeat.
navigates_to.title: Navigates To

ScreenPlan.title: ScreenPlan

UnsupportedCategory.description: Why a requested feature is out of reach. New values may be added; handle unknown ones.
UnsupportedCategory.title: UnsupportedCategory

UnsupportedRequest.description: A requirement the generator cannot build. Shown to the user; never silently dropped.

requirement.description: What the user asked for, in the planner's words (one line, shown to people).
requirement.title: Requirement

reason.description: Why it is not part of the app (one line).
reason.title: Reason

alternative.description: What the app does instead, if anything (one line).
alternative.title: Alternative

UnsupportedRequest.title: UnsupportedRequest

description:
The application a user asked for: a name, 1 to 12 static screens and how they connect.

Rules beyond the field limits: screen ids are unique ignoring letter case; start_screen (default:
the first screen) exists; every navigation target exists, is not its own screen and is not
repeated on a screen; every screen can be reached from the start screen by pressing buttons.
Requirements that cannot be built are listed in unsupported_requests, never dropped. The package
name and all Android settings are not part of this document (they come from AndroidTarget).

app_name.description: Display name of the app (display text, up to 50 characters). Proposed by the planner, shown to the user, used as the project's name once approved.
app_name.title: App Name

summary.description: One or two plain sentences for the approval screen. Shown to people only; never put into code or resources.
summary.title: Summary

start_screen.description: Id of the screen the app opens on. Defaults to the first screen.
start_screen.title: Start Screen

unsupported_requests.description: Everything the user asked for that the generator cannot build.
unsupported_requests.title: Unsupported Requests
